ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (25) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Lichtenberg's first question «Что такое я?» (Chto takoe ya?) is 'What am I?', where the website draft had 'What is the self?'; the italics of the three questions follow the print. «Уразумение» (urazumenie, 'comprehension') is kept apart from «разумение» (razumenie, 'understanding'); attributions follow the print (Thoreau, Carlyle, the Talmud, Pascal, Chinese wisdom).
Source observation: [15] «гордятся, как мудростью, тем; что» has a stray semicolon where a comma is meant; translated as a continuous clause
